cases.assertion: tree returns only nodes below the authorized workspace root
read rejects a file or line window above the configured limit with a bounded error
log returns a bounded window/cursor and does not require the full log
repeating discard for the same authorized workspace is safe and has one observable result
copy rejects missing, nested, existing, or quota-exceeding targets
tenant, user, session, and workspace scopes cannot read or mutate one another
.. segments, absolute paths, NUL bytes, and root escapes are rejected
symlink traversal and host mount paths cannot escape the workspace root
tree/read/log/copy responses, events, traces, and errors contain no SecretStore value or Git credential
without EnvironmentService/ledger query, /env cannot claim ready, reused, or expiry
old event names and Last-Event-ID resume remain consumable when new fields are added
clients do not treat an unknown environment or workspace state as successful
